tests.name: Multi-Doc Throughput (100 × 100)
tests.detail: 100 documents × 100 records = 10,000 total. Throughput: 1,600,999 records/sec. Multi-document streaming is a first-class capability.

tests.name: Multi-Doc Boundary Cost vs Single Document
tests.detail: Multi-doc: 1,637,090 ops/s. Single-doc: 1,693,910 ops/s. Boundary cost: 3.4%. Document isolation is free.

tests.name: Multi-Doc — docHeader.id Resets Per Document
tests.detail: 100/100 unique docHeader.id values captured. docHeader getter resets correctly on each @DOC boundary.
